P: Ādāna，（nt.） [ād + āna，or directly from ā + dā，base 1 of dadāti] taking up，getting，grasping，seizing； fig. appropriating，clinging to the world，seizing on （worldly objects）. （1） （lit.） taking （food），pasturing M.III，133； J.V，371 （& °esana）. -- （2） getting，acquiring，taking，seizing S.II，94； A.IV，400 （daṇḍ°）； PvA.27 （phal°）； esp. freq. in adinn° seizing what is not given，i. e. theft：see under adinna. -- （3） （fig.） attachment，clinging A.V，233，253 （°paṭinissagga）； Dh.89 （id.； cp. DhA.II，163）； Sn.1103 （°taṇhā），1104 （°satta）； Nd1 98 （°gantha）； Nd2 123，124. --an° free from attachment S.I，236 （sādānesu anādāno “not laying hold mong them that grip” trsl.）； A.II，10； It.109； J.IV，354； Miln.342； DhA.IV，70 （= khandhādisu niggahaṇo）. (gala gilādane); Ja V 371, 26* (ajja me sattamā ratti ~āni upāsato; Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ādānāni); 374, 22* (pahūtaṃ cādanaṃ tattha, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se khādanaṃ); Cp-a 249, 2 (manussānaṃ ~ato khādanato porisādo ti laddhanāmena); — °’- esanā , f. , search for food ; Ja V 371, 28* (carato ~aṃ; Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ādanesanaṃ).

1 dāna n. (aṭṭha °-vatthūni āsajja ~aṃ deti bhayā ~aṃ deti …); M II 62, 2 (āyasmā Raṭṭhapālo sakapitu nivesane n’ eva ~aṃ alattha na paccakkhānaṃ); S I 58, 9 (tassa mayhaṃ bhante catusu dvāresu ~aṃ dīyittha); A I 162, 25* (bahiddhā dadanti ~āni, Ce, Se so; Be denti; Ee ~ā); III 41, 2 (pañc’ ime bhikkhave ~e ānisaṃsā); V 269, 8 (idaṃ ~aṃ petānaṃ ñātisālohitānaṃ upakappatu); Khp 8:6 (yassa ~ena sīlena saṃyamena damena ca nidhī sunihito hoti); Dhp 223 (jine kadariyaṃ ~ena); It 98, 1 (dve ’māni bhikkhave ~āni āmisadānaṃ ca dhammadānaṃ ca); Pv 4:1 (dajjā ~aṃ amaccharī); Ja I 2, 27 (rañño ārocetvā nagare bheriṃ carāpetvā mahājanassa ~aṃ datvā tāpasapabbajjaṃ pabbaji); 74, 18 (atha Māro mahāpurisaṃ āha Siddhattha tuyhaṃ ~assa dinnabhāve ko sakkhī ti); III 12, 1* (adeyyesu dadaṃ ~aṃ); 473, 13 (khayabhīrukassa hi ~aṃ natthi); IV 64, 8* (maccherā ca pamādā ca evaṃ ~aṃ na diyyati); 402, 25* (yaṃ kiñci mānusaṃ ~aṃ adinnaṃ me na vijjati); 461, 18* (vinā pi ~ā); VI 97, 18* (~aṃ vā brahmacariyaṃ vā katamaṃ su mahapphalaṃ); 494, 26* (na hi ~ā paraṃ atthi patiṭṭhā sabbapāṇinaṃ); 547, 15* (tato kumāre ādāya … brāhmaṇassa adā ~aṃ); Ap 4, 19 (manasā ~aṃ mayā dinnaṃ); 267, 2 (ekachattassa ~ena duggatiṃ nūpapajj’ ahaṃ); Vibh 422, 5 (~aṃ datvā sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā kattha upapajjanti); Kv 543, 15 (arahā ~aṃ dadeyyā ti); Mil 276, 14 foll. (yo paraṃ dukkhāpetvā ~aṃ deti api nu taṃ ~aṃ sukhavipākaṃ hoti saggasaṃvattanikan ti); Vism 223, 5 (antamaso ekālopamattaṃ pi ~aṃ adatvā na bhuñjissāmī ti); It-a II 131, 21 (dātabbaṃ savatthukā vā cetanā ~aṃ, sampattipariccāgass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Pj II 405, 32 (yañño yāgo ~an ti atthato ekaṃ); Saddh 213; Sadd 368, 14 (~an ti dātabbaṃ dadanti etenā ti atthena deyyadhammo dānacetanā ca vuccati); — ifc see agga- ( sv agga 1 ), aggaḷa-, aggi-, iṇa-, kaññā-, tuṭṭhi-, patti- ( sv patti 2 ), mahā- ( sv maha[t] ); — °’- agga , n. [dāna + agga 2 ], a hall where alms are distributed ; Ja II 368, 24 (kadā rājā ~aṃ āgacchissatī ti); III 470, 11 (so ekadivasaṃ ~aṃ olokento mayhaṃ dānaṃ dussīlā lolasattā bhuñjanti); VI 487, 21 (~e dānaṃ bhuñjitvā); 503, 34´ (Vessantarassa ~e suraṃ na labhimhā ti vattuṃ mā labhantū ti); Mp I 431, 27 (~asmiṃ uccāsaddaṃ mahāsaddaṃ sutvā); Pv-a 124, 10 (~e pariccāgaṭṭhāne); Ap-a 521, 5 (kiṃ nu kho amhākaṃ ~e n’ atthī ti); — ~-parivahanaka, ~-parivāhaka, mfn. , who supervises, manages, the alms hall ;? [dāna + pati 2 ], a lord of liberality, a very generous giver ; D I 137, 24 (saddho dāyako ~i anāvaṭadvāro, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-patiko; Sv 298, 6 foll. ); S I 174, 8* (punappunaṃ ~ī dadanti); A III 39, 12 (dāyakassa ~ino); Sn 487 (yo yācayogo ~ī gahaṭṭho); Pv 11:4; Ja I 349, 25 (mātāpitaro pan’ assa … dāyakā ~ino); VI 316, 21* (ahaṃ ca bhariyā ca manussaloke saddhā ubho ~ī ahumhā); Mil 279, 30 (nāhaṃ bhante Nāgasena Vessantarassa ~ino dānaṃ garahāmi); Saddh 275; — °- patika , m. , id. , Ja IV 69, 23 (tadā seṭṭhi ayaṃ ~o bhikkhu ahosi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~-bhikkhu); — °- pāramī , °-pāramitā, f. , the perfection of giving (the first of ten perfections) ; Ja I 25, 19 (bāhirakabhaṇḍa-pariccāgo ~ī nāma aṅgapariccāgo dāna-upapāramī nāma jīvitapariccāgo dānaparamatthapāramī nāmā ti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee aṅgapariccāgo pāramiyo nāma bāhirabhaṇḍa-pariccāgo upapāramiyo nāma jīvitapariccāgo paramatthapāramiyo nāmā ti); V 174, 29´ (sarīrassa pariccattabhāvo ~ī nāma hoti); Bv 2:116 (tadādakkhiṃ paṭhamaṃ ~iṃ); 117 (°-pāramitaṃ gaccha); Sv 651, 9 ; Ap-a 22, 18 (tvaṃ ito paṭṭhāya paṭhamaṃ ~iṃ pūreyyāsi); — °- vato in Ee at Ja IV 62, 16 is prob. wr; Be, Ce, Se dānavitto); — °- vitta , mfn. , devoted to giving; famous for giving ;? [dāna + sūra 1 ], a hero of giving, a very liberal giver ; Sv 298, 4 ; Mp III 249, 4 ; — °- soṇḍa , mfn. , intoxicated with giving, munificent ; Abh 723; — adāna , n. , 1. not giving; failure to give ; Pv 21:45 (~aṃ atidānaṃ ca nappasaṃsanti paṇḍitā); Ja V 387, 20* (~aṃ na upapajjati); Sv 384, 17 (~am eva sikkhāpetvā); — 2. not a proper or suitable gift ; Mil 278, 27 (dasa … dānāni loke ~-sammatāni); Mp IV 185, 4 (yāni pan’ etāni … ~an ti sammatāni, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee ~-sammatāni); — atidāna , n. , a very great gift; too great a gift; excessive giving ; Pv 21:45; Ja VI 132, 25* (~aṃ daditvāna avajjhe deva ghātetva); 525, 15* (~ena khattiyo pabbājito sakā raṭṭhā); Mil 277, 18 (~aṃ bhante Nāgasena Vessantarena raññā dinnaṃ); 277, 25 (~ena bhogakkhayaṃ upeti); 278, 2 (~aṃ mahārāja loke vidūhi vaṇṇitaṃ thutaṃ pasatthaṃ); Pv-a 130, 25 (~aṃ na dātabban ti); — see also natthudāna ( sv natthu ).

1 ādāna n. ( and m. ) [ S. ādāna, n. ], 1. ( i ) taking, grasping; holding on to; attachment ; S II 94, 9 (kāyassa … ~aṃ pi nikkhepanam pi; Spk II 98, 10 : ~an ti nibbatti); Sn 364 (~esu vineyya chandarāgaṃ); Ja III 118, 3* (sabbaṃ sakassa ~aṃ anādānaṃ tiṇassa ca); Paṭis I 32, 26 (~aṃ pajahato); Mil 161, 20 ; Vism 289, 33 (paṭinissaggānupassanāya ~ato cittaṃ mocento); Mp IV 190, 15 (daṇḍassa ~aṃ); Nidd-a I 115, 30 (adinnassa ~aṃ adinnādānaṃ, parassa haraṇaṃ theyyaṃ corikā ti vuttam hoti); Sadd 428, 6 (hara ~e); — ifc see att’- ( sv atta[n] ), adinn’- ( sv dadāti ), iṇ’-, daṇḍ’-; — ( ii ) (the grasping of) a view ; Ud-a 347, 17 (mayhaṃ diṭṭhi sundarā mayhaṃ ~o sundaro ti); — cf ādāya 2 ; — 2. taking food, foraging ; Ja V 371, 26* (ajja me sattamā ratti ~āni upāsato, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce adanāni; 372, 1´ [ Be, Ce ]: adanānī ti ~āni gocaragahanaṭṭhānānī ti, ayam eva vā pāṭho); — ādānaṃ in eds at Mp IV 30, 1 foll. is prob. wr for ādhānaṃ; — °- parihananalakkhaṇa , mfn. , of which the distinguishing mark is destroying what is taken up (so Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 162) ; Peṭ 117, 23 (~aṃ upādānaṃ, eds so; perhaps wr for ādāna-parigahaṇa-?); — °- satta , mfn. or m. [ādāna + satta 1 or satta 3 ], attached to grasping; ; Sn 1104 (na upādiyetha bhikkhu sato kiñcanaṃ sabbaloke ~e iti pekkhamāno pajaṃ imaṃ maccudheyye visattaṃ; Pj II 599, 17 foll. : ādātabbaṭṭhena ādānesu rūpādisu satte sabbaloke … ~e vā ādānābhiniviṭṭhe puggale); — anādāna , n. and mfn. , 1. ( n. ) lack of holding on to, of grasping; unattachment ; Ja III 118, 3* ; IV 354, 21´ (vītataṇho ~ena anādāno); Thī-a 41, 23 ; — 2. ( mfn. ) not grasping; free from attachment ; Dhp 352 (vītataṇho ~o; Dhp-a IV 70, 19 : ~o ti khandhādisu niggahaṇo); Sn 741 (vītataṇho ~o); Th 491 (vītataṇhā ~ā satta buddhā khayogadhā; Th-a II 205, 20 : ~ā ti anupādānā appaṭisandhikā vā); Mil 342, 14* ; Ud-a 202, 10 (~-taṃ dasseti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~’-atthaṃ); — sādāna , mfn. , grasping, being attached ; Dhp 406 (aviruddhaṃ viruddhesu … ~esu anādānaṃ; Dhp-a IV 180, 9 : ahaṃ maman ti gahitattā ~esu) = Sn 630; Ja IV 372, 2* (anadānassa ~o dātum arahāmi bhojanaṃ).

V 197, note 1; — 3. fig. seizing on, clinging to the world or worldly objects; attachment; nom. sg. dissati imassa catu-mahābhūtikassa kāyassa ~am pi nik- khepanam pi, S ll 94, 9 ( Ct.
